package.name: bonbon_sarvam_adapter
package.description: Honest Sarvam AI capability detector and client adapter for Indic- language ASR/TTS/translation. Sarvam is only ever used as the preferred Indic-language engine when official Edge package or API access is genuinely confirmed present in this environment (rule 3/12) -- this package never invents a download URL, never assumes access, and fails closed to the open-source fallback chain (sherpa-onnx / faster-whisper / Piper / whisper.cpp, see bonbon_ai_model_registry) whenever access cannot be confirmed. As of this pass, zero prior Sarvam integration exists anywhere in this repository -- every detector in this package reports `unavailable` honestly in this environment.
